---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for Agent Deck
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

**A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.**

## Problem / Use Case

**What problem does this feature solve? Or what workflow would it improve?**

Example: "I run multiple Claude Code instances across different projects and can't tell them apart on mobile..."

## Proposed Solution

**How would you like this feature to work?**

Example: "Show the project name or working directory in the agent card..."

## Alternatives Considered

**Have you thought of alternative solutions or workarounds?**

## Additional Context

**Screenshots, mockups, or examples from other tools:**

## Priority

**How important is this feature to you?**
- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Important (would use regularly)
- [ ] Critical (blocking my workflow)

## Willingness to Contribute

**Would you be willing to help implement this feature?**
- [ ] I can contribute code (I know Swift/JavaScript)
- [ ] I can help with testing
- [ ] I can provide feedback/iteration
- [ ] I can only provide the idea

---

**Checklist before submitting:**
- [ ] I have searched existing feature requests to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I have clearly explained the problem this solves
- [ ] I have described how I would like it to work
